subject.scene_narrative: A pair of hands processes a stack of financial paperwork at a tidy accounting desk. The left hand steadies a clipped ledger sheet with neat flat-line rows representing entries, while the right hand presses a circular approval stamp onto the top slip — the satisfying thunk of a transaction confirmed. Small coin stacks and a calculator anchor the corner, reading instantly as precise back-office finance work.
